name: Pamica Technology Corporation
summary: Pamica Technology Corporation engages in the research and development, production, and sale of mica insulation materials, glass fiber cloth, and new energy insulation materials in China and internationally. The company offers insulating mica paper, fire-resistant mica tape, resistance mica sheet, mica washer, and silicon crystal mica heater and parts. It also produces non-alkali fiberglass cloth in industrial and electronic grades, as well as new energy insulation materials, such as mica panels, mica separators, mica monitoring boards, and composite mica tapes used in power battery modules and energy storage systems.
